zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Central Business District & West Side, Somerville Section, Willard & Heights Section, Travell & Hawes School District
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.782%, with an equalization ratio of 76.5%.
Public education represents 66.8% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 23.4%.
Average residential assessment is $734,400, producing an average annual tax bill of $20,431.01.

neighborhoods.name: Central Business District & West Side
neighborhoods.character: Charming pedestrian downtown with upscale restaurants, historic train station, and walk-to-town colonials and townhomes
neighborhoods.description: Vibrant village center centered on East Ridgewood Avenue, famous for destination dining, boutique shopping, and direct commuter train access to NYC.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Strong commercial core provides substantial ratables mitigating residential municipal property tax rates.

neighborhoods.name: Somerville Section
neighborhoods.character: Spacious tree-lined avenues with classic center-hall colonials and renovated custom estates adjacent to Somerville Elementary
neighborhoods.description: Premier suburban residential zone characterized by deep landscaped lots, exemplary elementary school proximity, and historic architectural integrity.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: High assessed market valuations produce typical annual property tax bills between $19,000 and $28,000.

neighborhoods.name: Willard & Heights Section
neighborhoods.character: Elevated residential section with rolling topography, custom split-levels, modern architectural homes, and expansive properties
neighborhoods.description: Quiet hilltop neighborhood offering panoramic views and spacious suburban settings convenient to Willard School.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Top tier residential tax contributions with over 68% of the local property tax levy dedicated to Ridgewood Public Schools.

neighborhoods.name: Travell & Hawes School District
neighborhoods.character: Classic Ridgewood suburban neighborhood with manicured lawns, sidewalks, and proximity to Graydon Pool and Saddle River County Park
neighborhoods.description: Sought-after family neighborhood with direct pedestrian access to village parks, municipal swimming at Graydon Pool, and community recreation fields.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Stable ratables with low municipal tax appeal rates and consistent property appreciation.

equityAnalysis.summary: Ridgewood Village maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Ridgewood Village, homeowners pay an average of $20,431.01 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.5% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 76.5%, assessed values average ~76.5% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 66.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 23.4%, and Bergen County claims 9.8%.
